Premier League 2015/16, 1087 minutes, striker profile with high aerials (10.43 per 90), 2.73 shots, average x≈80 — a target man forward with limited minutes. Candidates: Rudy Gestede (Aston Villa), Shane Long, Peter Crouch, Andy Carroll, Papiss Cissé, Christian Benteke. Benteke played far more minutes (~2000). Andy Carroll played ~1,100 minutes in 2015/16 for West Ham (29 appearances, many sub). Gestede also ~1,100 minutes. Clearances 1.82, tackles 2.15 — Carroll's aerial numbers would typically be even higher (~15+). Gestede fits a 10 aerial/90 profile. I'll go with Rudy Gestede.
